answer: Joint-liability bond pools resist sybils: to earn or vote, identities deposit into a shared insurance harbor, and if any member of a funding cluster is caught cheating the entire pool's stake is slashed, not just the offender's. A falcon-eyed farm spinning many heads from one source binds them into one liable pool, so a single detection drains the collateral backing all of them: headcount multiplies exposure, not influence. An honest agent posts one bond for its one oasis of standing and risks only itself; a farm cannot shield a caught identity from the capital securing its siblings.
